question: Why is the mosquito the most lethal animal in the world?
answer: When a mosquito bites, it spits into the skin to numb it and help the blood flow. That is the moment it passes on malaria and other diseases in many countries, causing about 725,000 deaths a year. What kills is the substance it spits in, not the bite itself.
move: What kills is not the bite but what the mosquito spits in.
